references.finding: Colour restoration/enhancement and individual additive safety assessment support the bounded research demands; this gives no natural-origin health guarantee.

Natural, animal/mineral-derived and synthetic origins are distinguished; assessment considers chemical properties, toxicity and dietary exposure, so food-use evidence does not directly settle textile skin contact.
